    "channel": "app",
    "content": "test",
    "document_timestamp": 1771772694,
    "priority": "medium",
    "title": "Untitled",
    "user_id": "user_01"
  }
}
```

- The value `1771772694` is taken directly from the `timestamp` field of the `get_current_time` response.
- All other parameters are included as required.

This should resolve the validation error.
